views.label: 390-account
views.title: Account & data
headingText: Make sure it sounds like your business
views.text: YOUR WORKSPACE Account & data Manage your service preferences and download your customer records. YOUR NEXT STEP Make sure it sounds like your business Review your services, hours and the answers customers should hear. Review business rules This month Review each connection’s terms before starting paid service. Creating your workspace and choosing connections do not purchase a number or start a subscription. Your average job value (optional) Save All changes saved. With it, your monthly statement says what the jobs that would have gone to voicemail were worth, and compares with last month. Your data Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored. Download: bookings, leads, conversations (CSV, opens in Excel or Sheets), or customers as a CSV for manual handoff. Check your scheduling software’s import requirements before uploading. Texting terms your customers can read: https://connection-journey.fixture.invalid/policy?c=connection-ui-1 Service Pause or resume from the buttons at the top. To end the service: Cancel service
